hypothesis: On a mechanically feasibility-filtered subset of the pinned MASSIVE dataset, language-centroid removal will reduce locale leakage in the fixed multilingual encoder while preserving intent signal more specifically than generic centering and random controls.
claim_boundary: Frozen-encoder representation diagnostic only. No linguistic-relativity, cognition, translation-quality, universal-representation, fine-tuned-model, or model-superiority claim.

feasibility_evidence.observed_fact: Exactly 50 intents have minimum cell size >=15 across every pinned locale and both train/test splits.

dataset.intent_universe_rule: Include exactly those intents whose minimum count across every pinned locale and both pinned splits is >=15 in retained census artifact 9718525342.
dataset.selection: For each frozen locale and frozen intent, rank examples by SHA-256(seed || id); select the first 15 fit examples and first 15 evaluation examples. Fail closed if the recomputed admissible intent set differs from frozen_intents or any frozen cell has fewer than 15 rows.

primary_probe: nearest-centroid Euclidean classifier fit only on the fit split

transforms.language_centering: subtract each locale's fit-split embedding centroid from fit and evaluation embeddings of that locale
transforms.random_group_centering: assign records to 3 deterministic SHA-256 groups per seed and subtract fit centroids for those pseudo-groups
transforms.random_subspace: remove projection onto 2 deterministic Gaussian orthonormal directions per seed

metrics.specificity_margin: language_centering_normalized_reduction - max(global_centering, random_group_centering, random_subspace normalized reductions)

statistics.primary_reporting: Report every per-seed metric plus arithmetic mean across the five frozen seeds.
statistics.uncertainty: Report sample standard deviation and two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval across the five frozen seeds for aggregate metrics; descriptive only and not a replacement for the frozen success gate.
statistics.multiple_testing: No exploratory hypothesis family and no p-value based success criterion; no correction is used.

predeclared_falsifiers: Specificity margin <= 0, meaning a generic control matches or beats language centering.
The sign of the parent effect reverses.
The pinned data/model revisions cannot be materialized exactly or provenance hashes are missing.
The recomputed >=15 feasibility set differs from the 50 frozen intents, which is an infrastructure/provenance failure before outcome access.
stop_rules: Stop before encoder construction if dataset revision, fingerprints, frozen intent set, or minimum cell counts do not match the preregistration.
Stop and classify as infrastructure/provenance failure if the pinned model revision cannot be materialized exactly.
After any model outcome is produced, retain the complete result regardless of success or failure; do not rescue-tune under this protocol ID.
Execute at most once under this exact frozen protocol unless a rerun is solely to reproduce the unchanged protocol and is labeled as reproduction.

artifacts.retention_rule: Retain raw metrics and all provenance artifacts for positive, mixed, negative, and infrastructure-failure outcomes.

authorization_gate: Authorization may become true only after the runner filters to frozen_intents before encoder construction, independently recomputes and asserts the >=15 census set equals frozen_intents, manifest-lock tests pass on the exact commit, and exact-head CI is green. Authorization must be committed before any v3 outcome access.
scientific_integrity: No outcome-dependent intent selection, threshold movement, seed changes, encoder swapping, control deletion, rescue tuning, or superiority claim without strong matched evidence.
